research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: GBatteries is focused on developing advanced fast charge technology. Their research includes methods and systems for temperature-based battery charging, which involve determining the battery pack's temperature and comparing it to a reference value to optimize charging. Additionally, they are working on reconfigurable multi-core battery packs, which involve a controller receiving communications from an external unit to adjust the battery configuration. These efforts aim to enhance battery efficiency and adaptability.
